summary: Make TinyDB's JSONStorage write db.json keys sorted by default, with an opt-out, so committed fixture diffs stop being noisy.
narrative: The owner asked on Nov 3 for JSONStorage to sort keys by default because db.json fixtures committed in their service repo produce noisy diffs when key order shifts. They also wanted a way to turn sorting off. The only recorded work is an exploration: the agent located the JSONStorage kwargs path in tinydb/storages.py and found existing sort_keys usage (observation #1). No code change, PR or release is recorded yet, so the request is at the exploration stage.

milestones.text: Owner asked for sorted keys by default in JSONStorage output, with an opt-out.
Agent located the JSONStorage kwargs path and existing sort_keys usage in storages.py.
